title: Eleven Winters in the Barn
subtitle: 生物与生灵 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生物与生灵（自然生态·动物与生命）
meta: 主题语境：生物与生灵（自然生态·动物与生命）　|　核心词汇：creature　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 creature 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my grandmother ① fed a creature that came to the barn for eleven winters, and she said the feeding was the whole of the knowing. The ② creature, meaning the animal and not the name, took milk from a saucer and stayed that wary; creature, she said, is the only thing in a barn that is judged by how little it lets itself be named.

Every ③ creature in that field had the same hour, and the ④ creature at the end, meaning the one she never touched and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever watched twice. Creature, my mother said, is nine parts hour and one part somebody willing to wait; my grandmother said the waiting is the part that fills eleven winters.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the creature was the whole of the story, meaning the person being described and not the animal. The ⑥ creature, meaning the person and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody pities and nobody defends; creature, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both an animal and a person. She said the person is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ creature had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the hour. The ⑧ creature of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in December, was one saucer and thirty years of waiting; creature, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to watch. He said the watching was never mentioned.

The ⑨ creature I remember is the one at the end, which came in 1967 and is still described as the wariest in the county. A ⑩ creature, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being watched; every creature, she said, is a person that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the person was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 动物（指那个生灵本身，与那个名字相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed a creature 喂养一只动物
D. n. 动物（指那片地里每一只）
E. n. 动物（指末尾那一只）
F. n. 人；家伙（指被描述的那个人，带感情色彩）
G. n. 动物（指笔记里提到的那一只）
H. n. 生灵；造物（抽象总称）

items.q: fed a creature that came to the barn for eleven winters
The creature, meaning the animal and not the name
the creature was the whole of the story
the creature had become a line in a notebook
The creature of the whole thing
A creature, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: feed a creature 意为“喂养一只动物”，1953 年祖母喂了一只来谷仓待了十一个冬天的动物。
creature 意为“生物、动物”，指那个生灵本身而不是那个名字，它从碟子里喝奶。
creature 指那片地里每一只动物，每一只都在同样的时辰出现。
creature 指末尾那一只（她从未碰过的那一只），是唯一有人看过两次的。
creature 可指“人、家伙”，父亲说那个人就是那个故事的全部，指的是被描述的那个人而不是那只动物。
creature 为另一个义项，指被描述的那个人而不是那只动物，是故事里人人都怜悯、却无人替他辩护的东西。
creature 意为“动物”，指笔记里提到的那一只，到 1961 年这只动物成了笔记里的一行。
creature 意为“生灵、造物”，祖母十二月写道，整件事的生灵是一只碟子三十年的等待。
creature 意为“生物、动物”，我记得的是末尾那一只，1967 年来过，至今仍被说成全县最警觉的。
creature 为抽象总称，母亲说一只动物是唯一会因为被注视而变好的东西。

末尾那一只动物，指的是她从未碰过的那一只，是唯一有人看过两次的。（creature）
父亲说那个人就是那个故事的全部，指的是被描述的那个人而不是那只动物。（creature）
1969 年母亲说，一只动物是唯一会因为被注视而变好的东西。（creature）
answers: In 1953 my grandmother fed a creature that came to the barn for eleven winters, and she said the feeding was the whole of the knowing.
The creature, meaning the animal and not the name, took milk from a saucer and stayed that wary.
Every creature in that field had the same hour.
The creature at the end, meaning the one she never touched and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever watched twice.
My father said the creature was the whole of the story, meaning the person being described and not the animal.
